name: Bruce Antone

items.text: A 2024 Fresh Take Florida review found his voter registration and campaign filings listed a Shenna Court home in House District 40, outside the district he represents. He changed his address after a reporter asked. He said he forgot to update his records. He also said opponents have "never proven" he lives outside the district.
items.why: This bears loosely on commitment to the area, but no court, House or ethics body has found wrongdoing, and he disputes that he lives outside the district.

for_review: The WUSF and WUFT pages loaded only their navigation text through the page-read tool, so I relied on the article text that came back in search results from the same pages, plus the Orlando Weekly republication and the Winter Garden Vox. I did not read the full original article in one piece. I found no House ruling and no result from the 2024 Florida Commission on Ethics complaint his primary opponent filed over residency. Someone should check both. The owner-sites search returned nothing about Antone, so owner_sites is empty. The WUSF page says he stopped answering questions and did not answer nine written questions. I left that out because the article's reporting there is about his response. The item as given says he changed his address in Jan. 2024. The article text I could read shows only that the change came the day after the reporter presented evidence, so that date still needs checking.
